contract.precondition: let cd : CashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk, oldSale : Sale = self.CurrentSale in if cd.oclIsUndefined() = true then false else CashDesk.allInstances()->includes(cd) and cd.IsOpened = true and (if oldSale.oclIsUndefined() = true then true else oldSale.IsComplete = true endif) endif
contract.postcondition: let cd : CashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk, newSale : Sale = self.CurrentSale, st : Store = self.CurrentCashDesk.BelongedStore in result = true and newSale.oclIsNew() = true and newSale.IsComplete = false and newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and newSale.BelongedCashDesk = cd and cd.ContainedSales->includes(newSale) and st.Sales->includes(newSale)
